joined_campaign.source: SkiiMaskTimmy Twitch livestreams and VODs only. No clips taken from his channel or clipping channels, recycled social edits, other creators, trailers or unrelated footage.
joined_campaign.branding: Use the campaign Twitch overlay. Keep Timmy's facecam and twitch.tv/skiimasktimmy on screen.
joined_campaign.audio: Keep the original stream audio audible. Do not cover Timmy's voice with music.
joined_campaign.format: Vertical 9:16, gameplay and facecam, English, at least seven seconds.
joined_campaign.distribution: TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts. Comments and likes on. No collabs or story boosting. Dedicated page recommended.
joined_campaign.post_caption: Include twitch.tv/skiimasktimmy and relevant tags such as #skiimasktimmy, #twitchclips, #fps, #gaming and the game name.
joined_campaign.submission: Submit through Content Rewards only. After 2,000 views, send a screen recording of video-specific watch times, view graphs and geographic analytics through the designated analytics submission form channel.
